violations.text: The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Hand-washing sink was observed being used as a dump sink in the prepare foods area. PIC cleaned out sink at time of inspection. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Chicken was observed held at (128) degrees Fahrenheit on bottom shelf of steam table. Employee reheated chicken to 188 degrees Fahrenheit at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Ham, flan, chicken and beef pastel were observed held at (50-57) degrees Fahrenheit. PIC voluntarily disposed of ham, flan, and chicken at time of inspection. All other TCS foods were moved to colder refrigeration. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

ROP Tilapia (35 degrees Fahrenheit) with instructions to keep frozen at -18C was observed thawing in display case. PIC removed tilapia from package and placed it in the walk-in at time of inspection. Proper ROP thawing was reviewed and ROP guidance was provided. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Working containers of (rice and flour) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026
The prep unit located in prepare foods area was observed draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026
The receptacle in the toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

Observed the outside dumpster overflowing with trash and not covered/closed. Per interview of PIC trash disposal company was not able to access dumpster area and will return Thursday & Friday to removed trash. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The floors in the following area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: -meat department W/I cooler & freezer The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/26/2026

The floors in the retail area, entrance to prepared foods area and meat department area is in poor repair. some ceiling tiles in retail area are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/26/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen, meat area and service line were lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/06/2025

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/06/2025

Deli meats and cheese were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 01/06/2025

At the time of inspection, ROP tilapia was thawing with package intact. Reduced oxygen packaging fish that bears a label indicating that it is to be kept frozen until time of use shall be removed from the reduced oxygen environment. Temperature was observed at 33 degrees Fahrenheit, PIC opened at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/06/2025

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings throughout establishment. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 01/20/2025
Door on deli case was not in good repair, observed cracked glass. New Violation. Correct By: 04/07/2025
The non-food contact surfaces of the retail shelving have an accumulation of rodent droppings. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/06/2025

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 01/20/2025

The walls in the mop sink and ice machine areas and door thresholds (restroom and kitchen) are constructed of painted sheetrock and have exposed wood. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2024
